args.body: Correction: the supported-source-types help link is a docs-discovery/setup-support aid, not evidence of activation lift. Please remove any activation-lift or activation-clarity claim from this change; first-sync/activation conversion has not materially changed. Keep invite-link status out of this PR as well—its copy/status work should remain a separate change and release note. Source-specific caveats belong in the supported-source-types docs/support guidance, not in a broader product or activation promise.
